description: Restore three separately drawn root supports from different reachable ledges in rooms 31 and 32.
Preview the three sources of a cloudy runnel and clear their visible leaf catches; incorrect catches are harmless and reversible.
Use three drying stations while preserving each cloth's visible safe moisture band; wrong settings reset freely.
Light three marked line-of-sight beacons while protecting the cloth screens; RESET restores a wrong arrangement.
Hold one pressure plate and turn two linked shutters while preserving a walkable loop and reachable return handle.
Align three shallow ore inspection sockets into a route diagram while leaving its central walking gap open.

Water for Both Banks: settle five distinct ordinary stations serially, with local support reassignment; inspect both dry shelves and equal middle level marks, using two intentional polarity switches. No survival timer or level requirement.
Connect the two taught roof-line endpoints without blocking the manual stairs.

Lay a figure-eight demonstration cord on a visible peg board with exactly one shared crossing. Linkeel tunes the crossing, the player follows both lobes and returns to the start without using the same lobe twice.
Use Frondfoal to trace the two side rails of a visible seed-ladder on separate tagged stems, then manually unfold its cross-frond. The open central notch must remain untraced.
Fold a three-panel living frond bridge into a pictured zigzag without overlapping its two narrow refuge pads. Palmstar binds the two visible joints from separate reachable landings.
Choose three corner reflectors from four large tagged pedestals so their outlined triangle surrounds a quiet central motif. Combgleam echoes the three selected corners; the unchosen fourth stays dim.
Set two independent chalk floats to opposite ballast states so a broad specimen tray sits at the middle pictured depth. Walk around its dry outline and show it can be approached from both sides.
Angle two translucent screens to light opposite triangular murals while leaving their drawn diagonal passage unlit. Combgleam demonstrates the two receivers in either order.
Turn an articulated bronze drawing around its fixed center pin. Linkeel aligns each of its two joints only when the previewed sweep misses a marked fragile frame.
Place two curved baffles so a drawn crescent remains silent while the nearby broad border is still echoed. Read both sample points with the same Inkbud; a fully silent room is not a solution.
Unfold a perforated screen over two large outlined motifs. Slide the screen until both different-shaped motifs remain visible through its two windows, then close only its outer rim with Rimlet.
